title: On-device semantic search
content:
# On-device semantic search

Mirrors the desktop bge-small semantic search on mobile, but runs fully on-device via Apple's NLContextualEmbedding (NaturalLanguage framework).

## Why NLContextualEmbedding
Chosen over shipping the desktop ONNX model: no model bundle, no native runtime, no tokenizer. The OS provides the model and downloads assets on demand.

## Centering fix
Mean-pooled vectors share a common component that crushes cosine into a narrow band. Subtracting the corpus centroid restores discrimination. A title-weighted lexical score is blended in so keyword-heavy queries surface the right note.

title: Kanban board drag and drop
content:
# Kanban board drag and drop

## Gestures
The board uses react-native-gesture-handler and reanimated worklets to reorder cards between columns with a long-press drag, updating card order on the UI thread for a smooth 60fps interaction.

title: iCloud sync engine
content:
# iCloud sync engine

## Conflicts
Bidirectional offline-first sync over a shared iCloud folder. Diverged note bodies are kept as a conflicted copy so nothing is lost; a hybrid logical clock (HLC) orders operations deterministically across devices.

title: Sourdough bread recipe
content:
# Sourdough bread recipe

## Method
Mix flour, water, salt and an active starter. Bulk ferment for four hours with stretch and folds, shape, cold proof overnight, then bake in a dutch oven at 250C for a crisp crust.

title: Architecture: Persistence Layer
content:
# Architecture: Persistence Layer

All data lives in SQLite via better-sqlite3. The renderer talks to the main process over IPC. Notes are written to both a markdown file and a SQLite row simultaneously.

title: Knowledge Graph redesign
content:
# Knowledge Graph redesign

Force-directed and radial layouts render every project, note, card and tag wired by their explicit links. Semantic edges overlay dashed accent links between topically similar notes.
